svg.title: Register map
svg.text: The port is word-addressed in hardware; the interconnect does the divide-by-four, so software uses these offsets directly.
four sticky faults, six live status bits
one mask bit per sticky fault
cycles WITHOUT PROGRESS before giving up
start address of the latched fault
first byte of window i, inclusive
last byte of window i, inclusive
STATUS (0x04) — bits 3:0 sticky, write 1 to clear
